The Kentucky Facility currently has approximately 137 MW of developed capacity.

We are targeting the Kentucky Facility to reach a total capacity of approximately 232 MW through the remainder of 2026, with additional expansion anticipated.

Additionally, in January 2026, we announced the execution of the AMD Lease to provide 25 MW of critical IT load capacity at the Rockdale Facility.

We expect the Corsicana Facility to reach approximately 1 GW of developed capacity upon full buildout and it is being designed to support high-density compute workloads.

Our fleet totals 1,200 MW across sites.
